text:
Predicates:
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Nationality(x, y) ::: x has nationality y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Born(ailtonSilva, year1995) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995.
KnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton is a football player.
LoanedTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: who was loaned out to Braga.
Nationality(ailtonSilva, brazilian) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ::: Nautico is a football club.
FootballClub(braga) ::: along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬LoanedTo(ailtonSilva, y) ∧ FootballClub(y) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to a football club.
